description: Defines classes and APIs for managing MoCA interfaces in a TR-069 compliant device, including device and interface singleton classes, getter and setter methods for interface parameters, and related constants.

classes.name: MoCADevice
classes.description: Singleton class managing the MoCA device context and RMH (Remote Management Handler) context.

classes.name: MoCAInterface
classes.description: Represents a MoCA network interface with parameters and methods to get/set interface properties, including status, configuration, and statistics.

methods.name: get_InterfaceNumberOfEntries
methods.description: Returns the number of MoCA interface entries.

methods.name: check_MoCABootStatus
methods.description: Provides information about MoCA boot status and network discovery.

methods.name: get_Enable
methods.description: Gets whether the MoCA interface is enabled.

methods.name: get_Status
methods.description: Gets the operational status of the interface (Up, Down, etc.).

methods.name: get_Alias
methods.description: Gets the alias label for the interface.

methods.name: get_Name
methods.description: Gets the name of the interface.

methods.name: get_LastChange
methods.description: Gets the time since the last status change.

methods.name: get_LowerLayers
methods.description: Gets the list of lower layer interface paths.

methods.name: get_Upstream
methods.description: Indicates if the interface points towards the Internet.

methods.name: get_MACAddress
methods.description: Gets the MAC address of the interface.

methods.name: get_FirmwareVersion
methods.description: Gets the firmware version of the MoCA interface.

methods.name: get_MaxBitRate
methods.description: Gets the maximum PHY bit rate in Mbps.

methods.name: get_MaxIngressBW
methods.description: Gets the maximum ingress bandwidth in Mbps.

methods.name: get_MaxEgressBW
methods.description: Gets the maximum egress bandwidth in Mbps.

methods.name: get_HighestVersion
methods.description: Gets the highest supported MoCA version.

methods.name: get_CurrentVersion
methods.description: Gets the current MoCA network version.

methods.name: get_NetworkCoordinator
methods.description: Gets the Node ID of the current Network Coordinator.

methods.name: get_NodeID
methods.description: Gets the Node ID of the interface.

methods.name: get_MaxNodes
methods.description: Indicates if the interface supports 16 nodes (MoCA 1.1) or 8 nodes (MoCA 1.0).

methods.name: get_PreferredNC
methods.description: Indicates if the interface is a preferred Network Coordinator.

methods.name: get_BackupNC
methods.description: Gets the backup Network Coordinator Node ID.

methods.name: get_PrivacyEnabledSetting
methods.description: Gets whether link-layer security is enabled for network admission.

methods.name: get_PrivacyEnabled
methods.description: Gets whether link-layer security is currently enabled.

methods.name: get_FreqCapabilityMask
methods.description: Gets the supported frequency spectrum mask.

methods.name: get_FreqCurrentMaskSetting
methods.description: Gets the configured enabled frequency mask.

methods.name: get_FreqCurrentMask
methods.description: Gets the current used frequency mask.

methods.name: get_CurrentOperFreq
methods.description: Gets the current operational RF frequency in Hz.

methods.name: get_LastOperFreq
methods.description: Gets the last RF frequency in Hz when interface was up.

methods.name: get_KeyPassphrase
methods.description: Gets the MoCA password (numeric, returns empty string on read).

methods.name: get_TxPowerLimit
methods.description: Gets the transmit power attenuation in dB.

methods.name: get_PowerCntlPhyTarget
methods.description: Gets the target PHY rate in Mbps for power control.

methods.name: get_BeaconPowerLimit
methods.description: Gets the beacon transmit power attenuation in dB.

methods.name: get_NetworkTabooMask
methods.description: Gets the taboo channel mask for the home network.

methods.name: get_NodeTabooMask
methods.description: Gets the supported frequency taboo mask.

methods.name: get_TxBcastRate
methods.description: Gets the broadcast PHY transmit rate in Mbps.

methods.name: get_TxBcastPowerReduction
methods.description: Gets the transmit power reduction for broadcast in dB.

methods.name: get_QAM256Capable
methods.description: Indicates if 256 QAM modulation is supported.

methods.name: get_PacketAggregationCapability
methods.description: Gets the packet aggregation support level.

methods.name: get_AssociatedDeviceNumberOfEntries
methods.description: Gets the number of associated devices.

methods.name: get_X_RDKCENTRAL_COM_MeshTableNumberOfEntries
methods.description: Gets the number of mesh table entries.

methods.name: get_X_RDKCENTRAL_COM_PrimaryChannelFreq
methods.description: Gets the primary channel frequency.

methods.name: get_X_RDKCENTRAL_COM_SecondaryChannelFreq
methods.description: Gets the secondary channel frequency.

methods.name: get_X_RDKCENTRAL_COM_TurboMode
methods.description: Gets the turbo mode status.

methods.name: get_X_RDKCENTRAL_COM_NodePowerState
methods.description: Gets the node power state.

methods.name: set_Enable
methods.description: Enables or disables the interface.

methods.name: set_Alias
methods.description: Sets the alias label for the interface.

methods.name: set_LowerLayers
methods.description: Sets the lower layer interface list.

methods.name: set_PreferredNC
methods.description: Sets whether the interface is a preferred Network Coordinator.

methods.name: set_PrivacyEnabledSetting
methods.description: Sets the privacy mode for network admission.

methods.name: set_FreqCurrentMaskSetting
methods.description: Sets the enabled frequency mask.

methods.name: set_TxPowerLimit
methods.description: Sets the transmit power attenuation.

methods.name: set_PowerCntlPhyTarget
methods.description: Sets the target PHY rate for power control.

methods.name: set_KeyPassphrase
methods.description: Sets the MoCA password.

methods.name: set_BeaconPowerLimit
methods.description: Sets the beacon power attenuation.
